items.excerpt: European leaders have said they are ready for negotiations with Russia on ending the war in Ukraine, in a strong show of support for Kyiv. items.title: Somalia’s constitutional overhaul tests its fragile federal bargain
items.description: Mohamud’s reforms promise stronger government, but regional resistance and violence threaten the fragile deal of 2012.
items.imageCaption: Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud addresses an emergency joint session of parliament in Mogadishu [Handout/Somali Presidency] | The seven federal member states of Somalia (Al Jazeera)
items.author: Faisal Ali
items.excerpt: President Mohamud’s reforms promise stronger government, but regional resistance and violence threaten the fragile deal of 2012. Mogadishu, Somalia – A day before Somalia’s Supreme Court was due to rule on whether President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud had lawfully extended his term by a year, he abruptly dismissed the chief justice presiding over the case. On November 4, the presidency removed Chief Justice Bashe Yusuf Ahmed, citing complaints about the administration of justice.
